title: System Design & Distributed Architecture
description: Design scalable distributed systems, understand CAP theorem, implement microservices patterns, and handle consistency in distributed environments.
longDescription: Learn to architect systems that scale: microservices vs monoliths, service mesh patterns, eventual consistency, saga pattern for distributed transactions, event-driven architecture, and API design principles (REST, GraphQL, gRPC).
whatYouLearn: CAP theorem and distributed consistency tradeoffs
